== Biography ==

The Eaglet is a young bird of forthright disposition and ready wit. Among the creatures drawn into the pool and washed ashore, the Eaglet distinguishes itself by its candid speech. When the Dodo launches into a pronouncement laden with long words, the Eaglet demands plainness, declaring it can understand scarcely half such verbose language and casting doubt upon the Dodo's own comprehension. In this moment of candid criticism, the Eaglet bends its head to conceal a smile, whilst the other birds titter audibly at its boldness.
